name: auto-ontology
description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
one_liner: A tool that teaches a company's AI chatbot what its own data actually means, so it gives correct numbers instead of confident guesses.
buyer: A data or analytics leader at a mid-size company whose internal 'ask my data' chatbot keeps giving wrong revenue or metric numbers.
business_use_cases: A systems integrator deploys it for retail or finance clients to make an internal 'chat with your data' tool trustworthy, billed as a project.
A BI consultancy runs 'AI-ready data catalog' audits that reconcile inconsistent metric definitions across a client's departments.
A reseller offers managed hosting of it for mid-market companies that don't want to run their own Kubernetes/NVIDIA NIM stack.

money_ideas.idea: Managed hosting + setup for companies wanting trustworthy 'chat with your data' without running the infrastructure themselves
One-off ontology/implementation consulting per client dataset

steal_this: Offer a one-day 'ontology audit': run this against a client's sales database and hand them a cleaned semantic catalog plus a working natural-language query demo.
